messages.subject: Research coordinator position at UGA
messages.body_plain:
Hi again,

James Martin and I are recruiting a new research coordinator here at the University of Georgia. We're looking for someone with good quantitative and organizational skills. Please spread the word.

https://www.ugajobsearch.com/postings/62980

Thanks,
Richard
